procedure: vite build of a one-button app per UI lane (MUI <Button variant=contained>, Tailwind bg-blue-600 button)
serve dist with a node http server that adds exactly one header: Content-Security-Policy OR Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
Playwright: addInitScript collects securitypolicyviolation events; page console 'error' messages collected; computed background-color of the button

consoleErrors: Applying inline style violates the following Content Security Policy directive 'style-src 'self''. Either the 'unsafe-in…

alsoObserved: vite build index.html contains no inline <script> (one <script type=module src>) — script-src 'self' suffices
vite preview with preview.headers {'Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only': ...} serves the header and securitypolicyviolation fires with disposition 'report' (MUI lane, style-src-elem)
React 19.2.7 renderToString: href='javascript:…' (incl. case/space variants) is replaced by a throwing javascript: URL; href='data:text/html,…' is passed through

template VITE_CONFIG extracted verbatim with .env.production VITE_API_URL=https://api.production.example.com: vite preview served Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only with connect-src 'self' https://api.production.example.com plus X-Frame-Options: DENY
vite preview without --mode used .env.production (connect-src … api.production…); with --mode dev it used .env.dev (connect-src … api.dev…) — the e2e webServer now passes the build mode
conclusions: MUI (Emotion) needs style-src 'unsafe-inline' (or a per-request nonce) — strict style-src leaves components unstyled when enforced
Tailwind v4 lane works under strict style-src
Report-Only violations are events, not console errors — a smoke test asserting no console errors does not fail on them
an empty violation list without the header in the response is 'not measured', so the smoke attachment records the applied header
limits: one page, one component per lane; not a crawl of a real app
